title: chat-server: owner self-ops key on principal_id, not accountId
description: jmap-chat-spec cefc217 §Terminology Owner: 'a client-facing reference to the owner carries the accountId of the owner's account'. Group self-leave (chat.rs apply_member_patch_keys: removeMembers == [caller_id]), Space self-removal and self-nick (space.rs caller_identity), SpaceBan own-record visibility and bannedBy (space.rs/ban.rs), invitedBy/createdBy (invite.rs, emoji.rs) compare against B::principal_id(caller), falling back to accountId only when principal_id is None. With a multi-user backend that sets principal_id != accountId, removeMembers=[accountId] is not recognised as self-leave and own-record checks miss. Needs a decision: map principal->accountId at the seam for owner references, or document that chat accounts require principal_id == accountId. Found while fixing JMAP-405z.2 (single-user posture already conforms).

Chat/typing participation check (chat.rs:1020) also keys on principal_id; not covered.
